info.title: Kalshi Clearing Member API
info.description:
Klear API endpoints available to clearing members —
institutional users who clear margin activity directly with
Kalshi.

## Authentication

All endpoints require an admin access token passed in the `Authorization` header:

`Authorization: Bearer <admin_user_id>:<access_token>`

To generate an access token and obtain your admin user id, sign in at
https://klearing.kalshi.com, and navigate to the "Security" page.

If you are in the process of onboarding to be a clearing member,
please contact your contact at Kalshi for credentials. Otherwise,
please contact institutional@kalshi.com.

the current cycle across all asset classes, ordered by asset class

Kalshi Klear; a positive amount indicates a net receivable. Empty
when no obligation is pending.

get.description: Positions of the authenticated clearing member that meet the CFTC large-trader reporting levels for a settlement day (17 CFR 15.03(b); each row's reportable_threshold is its market's level), plus exit-day positions that were reportable on the prior settlement day and are now below the threshold. Members with reportable positions are subject to their own CFTC Part 17 large-trader reporting obligations; this endpoint provides the position data needed to meet them. Empty when no positions meet the reporting levels and no prior-day reportable positions need exit reporting. See the CFTC's Large Trader Reporting Program (https://www.cftc.gov/IndustryOversight/MarketSurveillance/LargeTraderReportingProgram/index.htm) and reporting levels at 17 CFR 15.03 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-I/part-15).

parameters.name: report_date
parameters.description: ET settlement day to report

post.description: Maintenance margin requirement in dollars for a hypothetical portfolio, margined under the rules that apply to the authenticated clearing member. Positions and prices are supplied by the caller and need not reflect positions held. Every market in `positions` must belong to `asset_class`. The response includes the component breakdown of the estimate; see the response schema for the semantics of each component.

get.description: Inputs to the maintenance margin calculation for an asset class.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Return the matrices calibrated on this Eastern-time day (YYYY-MM-DD), the liquidation parameters in effect at the end of that day, and the current subgroups of the markets they cover for the caller. Returns 404 if no matrices were calibrated that day.

get.summary: Get Settlement Estimate By Asset Class
get.description: Estimated next settlement amounts for the authenticated clearing member, keyed by asset class, including per-subtrader and per-group breakdowns. Asset classes where the member has no margin activity are omitted. `subtrader_breakdowns` and `group_breakdowns` together contain at most the 1,000 entries with the largest maintenance margin requirement; `omitted_subtrader_count` and `omitted_group_count` report how many entries of each type were left out. `user_breakdown` always aggregates across all subtraders.

get.summary: Get Funding Estimate By Asset Class
get.description: Estimated funding at the next scheduled funding time for the authenticated clearing member, keyed by asset class.
Returns an asset class's funding schedule as a cron expression evaluated in US Eastern Time. Funding executes at each scheduled tick; schedules differ by asset class.
Settlement (mark) prices for the markets in an asset class at a given settlement time. Empty when no settlement has run for that asset class and settlement time.

parameters.description: Settlement cycle time

get.description: Get the status of a settlement balance withdrawal by ID.
List the clearing member's margin subtrader groups and their members.

post.description: Create a margin subtrader group. Grouped subtraders are margined as one netted portfolio at each settlement.

put.description: Replace a margin subtrader group's membership.

delete.description: Delete a margin subtrader group if it exists.

post.description: FCM clearing members only. Mint an API key bound to one of your margin subtraders using an RSA or Ed25519 public key you supply. The binding is set at mint and immutable; the resulting key is the institution's trading credential for that subtrader and cannot reach any REST endpoint, including key management.

409.description: The bound subtrader is not yet visible in the credential registry, which updates asynchronously. Retry shortly after creating the subtrader.

get.description: FCM clearing members only. List your API keys that carry a subtrader binding, optionally filtered to one subtrader.

parameters.name: fcm_subtrader_id
parameters.description: Return only keys bound to this subtrader.

post.description: FCM clearing members only. Mint a subtrader-bound API key with a platform-generated RSA key pair. The private key appears exactly once in this response and cannot be retrieved again; store it securely before leaving the page or discarding the response.

409.description: The bound subtrader is not yet visible in the credential registry, which updates asynchronously. Retry shortly after creating the subtrader.

delete.description: FCM clearing members only. Permanently revoke a subtrader-bound API key. Revocation cannot be undone; the institution's live sessions on this key are terminated.

report_type.description: Report file type. Every type is a CSV except `daily_statement`, the end-of-day PDF statement that lays out the same date's position, trade, settlement, funding, and cash files with an account summary.

date.description: The ET report date the file belongs to. Intraday snapshots after 4pm ET belong to the next report date.

snapshot_ts.description: Snapshot instant for intraday files (noon and hourly cycles); omitted for end-of-day files.

AssetClass.description: Asset class of the margin markets covered by this entry.

amount_centicents.description:
Net settlement amount in USD as centicents (1 USD = 10,000
centicents). All monetary fields on this API are returned in
centicents. Total the clearing member owes or is owed, inclusive
of PnL, fees, and maintenance margin changes. Negative means the
clearing member pays Kalshi Klear; positive means Kalshi Klear
pays the clearing member.

fees_centicents.description: Trading fees incurred during the settlement period.

maintenance_margin_centicents.description: Current maintenance margin requirement for this obligation.

pnl_centicents.description: Total PnL for this settlement period; the sum of the settlement details for this settlement cycle.

execution_time.description: Settlement cycle time this obligation belongs to.

last_updated_ts.description: Timestamp of the last status change on this obligation.

position_quantity_fp.description: Signed position at settlement as a fixed-point contract count (e.g. "1.25").

pnl_centicents.description: Total PnL for this market and subtrader over the settlement period

funding_time.description: The funding period this payment applies to.

position_quantity_fp.description: Signed position at funding time as a fixed-point contract count (e.g. "1.25").

notional_value_centicents.description: Signed notional value (position times mark price) the funding payment was computed from.

funding_amount_centicents.description: Signed funding amount; positive when received

subtrader_id.description: Empty when not populated or when the subtrader is part of a subtrader group.

margin_group_id.description: Set when the subtrader is part of a subtrader group.

maintenance_margin_centicents.description: Maintenance margin requirement after this settlement.

maintenance_margin_delta_centicents.description: Change in maintenance margin between the previous settlement and this one.

settlement_details.description:
Per-market, per-subtrader breakdown of the settlement amount.
This structure may change in future versions as margin
methodology evolves (e.g. portfolio margin).

maintenance_margin_details.description:
Breakdown of the maintenance margin requirement and the delta
from the prior settlement.

funding_payments.description:
Per-market, per-subtrader, per-funding-period breakdown of the
funding payments settled by this obligation.

settlement_details_truncated.description: Set when settlement_details was capped at the 1000-row inline limit; page the full set via /margin/obligations/{obligation_id}/settlement_details.

maintenance_margin_details_truncated.description: Set when maintenance_margin_details was capped at the 1000-row inline limit; page the full set via /margin/obligations/{obligation_id}/maintenance_margin_details.

funding_payments_truncated.description: Set when funding_payments was capped at the 1000-row inline limit; page the full set via /margin/obligations/{obligation_id}/funding_payments.

obligations.description: Outstanding settlement obligations for the current cycle across all asset classes, ordered by asset class then obligation ID. Empty when no obligation is pending.

report_date.description: ET settlement day the positions are reported for.

exit_day.description: True when this row is included because the same market was reportable on the prior settlement day but is now below the reportable threshold.

reportable_threshold.description: CFTC reporting level for this market, in contracts (17 CFR 15.03(b)). A position of at least this size in either direction is reportable.

market_ticker.description: Market to include in the hypothetical portfolio. Must belong to the request's asset class.

quantity.description: Signed whole contract count; positive long

price.description: Price of one contract in USD, to at most four decimal places (e.g. "6.8000"). Must be positive.

date.description: Margin the portfolio against the matrices calibrated on this Eastern-time day (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to use the current matrices. Returns 404 if no matrices were calibrated that day, or 400 if a requested market is absent from them.

clearing_type.description: Clearing arrangement whose margin rules to apply. Omit to use the arrangement on record for the authenticated clearing member.

positions.description: Hypothetical portfolio to margin. Market tickers must be unique and must name markets that exist in the requested asset class.

maintenance_margin_fp.description: Maintenance margin requirement for the submitted portfolio, in USD (e.g. "1234.5600"). Equals base_margin_fp + funding_addon_fp + liquidation_addon_fp, subject to per-market minimums on gross-margined markets and to each component being rounded individually, so the components need not sum exactly to this total.

base_margin_fp.description: Base scenario margin charged, in USD: the larger of the historical-VaR and APC candidates, taken per market for gross-margined markets and across the whole portfolio for portfolio-margined ones, then summed. Equals max(hvar_fp, apc_fp) only when the entire portfolio is portfolio-margined; with gross-margined markets it can exceed both.

hvar_fp.description: Portfolio total of the historical-VaR candidate for the base scenario margin, in USD.

apc_fp.description: Portfolio total of the APC candidate for the base scenario margin, in USD, computed over the pooled APC and augmented stress scenario set.

returns.description: One row per scenario; each row holds one return per entry in market_tickers.

base_tail_percentile.description: Lower-tail percentile of the scenario P&L distribution used for the base margin.

funding_tail_percentile.description: Lower-tail percentile of the scenario P&L distribution used for the funding margin.

liquidation_configs.description: Liquidation margin parameters for each active market with a calibrated margin config.

subgroups.description: Partition of the asset class's active markets; positions within a subgroup are margined together.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor; pass as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page. Absent when there are no more results.

session_avg_price_fp.description: Average entry price for the current settlement session

positions.description: Map of market ticker to that market's settlement estimate.

user_breakdown.description: Estimated next settlement for this asset class. Null when the member has no activity in this asset class.

subtrader_breakdowns.description: Map of subtrader ID to that portfolio's settlement estimate.

group_breakdowns.description: Map of margin group ID to that portfolio's netted settlement estimate.

omitted_subtrader_count.description: Number of subtraders omitted from subtrader_breakdowns. Their amounts are still included in user_breakdown.

omitted_group_count.description: Number of groups omitted from group_breakdowns. Their amounts are still included in user_breakdown.

next_runtime.description: Next settlement time for this asset class.

estimates.description: Map of asset class to the estimated next settlement for that asset class.

positions.description: Keyed by market ticker; only present on subtrader and group breakdowns.

next_funding_time.description: Next scheduled funding time for this asset class.

schedule.description: Cron expression evaluated in US Eastern Time (e.g. "0 */8 * * *" = midnight, 8AM and 4PM ET).

settlement_prices.description: Map of market ticker to that market's settlement (mark) price at the requested settlement time, in centicents. Empty when no settlement ran for that asset class and settlement time.

amount_centicents.description: Guaranty fund contribution balance. Zero when no contribution has been made yet.

updated_ts.description: Timestamp of the most recent contribution entry.

amount.description: Withdrawal amount in USD as a fixed-point string (e.g. "500.00").
Amount to withdraw in USD as a fixed-point string (e.g. "500.00"). Must be positive.

id.description: ID of the withdrawal. The withdrawal is processed asynchronously.

balance_delta_centicents.description: Change to the settlement buffer balance.

locked_balance_delta_centicents.description: Change to the locked settlement balance. Funds are locked during pending withdrawals.

business_transaction_id.description: Identifier of the business transaction that caused this entry.

created_ts.description: Timestamp when the entry was created.

cursor.description: Pass as the `cursor` query param to fetch the next page. Absent when there are no more results.

subtrader_ids.description: List of subtrader IDs belonging to the clearing member that will comprise the group. Subtraders must not belong to another group.
Full desired list of subtrader IDs belonging to the clearing member. Subtraders must not belong to another group.

name.description: Name identifying the key's purpose, e.g. the institution it is issued to.

public_key.description: RSA or Ed25519 public key in PEM format. Signatures on the institution's requests verify against it with the key's algorithm.

fcm_subtrader_id.description: The subtrader to bind, spelled {your_account_id}_{suffix} with a suffix of 1-16 characters of [a-z0-9]. Must already exist and belong to you.

warning.description: Present only when the bound subtrader is missing a per-subtrader risk control - the initial-margin cap (margin lane) or the event-contract daily cap. The mint still succeeds; the warning names each missing control - an event-contract subtrader without a daily cap has its event-contract orders rejected until one is set, while a margin subtrader without an initial-margin cap is bounded only by firm-level risk limits.

fcm_subtrader_id.description: The subtrader to bind, spelled {your_account_id}_{suffix} with a suffix of 1-16 characters of [a-z0-9]. Must already exist and belong to you.

private_key.description: RSA private key in PEM format. Returned exactly once and never stored; it cannot be retrieved again.
